passage:
Text 1
Many health guides recommend that every adult drink eight glasses of water a day.

Text 2
The eight-glass rule has little scientific basis. Much of the water people need comes from food and from other drinks, and the amount each person needs varies with body size, activity, and climate.
stem: Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the recommendation in Text 1?
choices: By arguing that a single fixed amount ignores other water sources and differences between people
By agreeing that eight glasses a day is the right amount of water for most active adults
By recommending that adults drink more than eight glasses of water every day in hot weather
By claiming that most people get all the water they need from food and never need to drink
steps: Text 1 gives one fixed amount for everyone.
Text 2 says the rule lacks evidence, food and drinks also supply water, and needs vary.
So the author would criticize a one-size-fits-all number.
Text 2 doesn't endorse the rule, prescribe a new amount, or say people never need to drink.
key: Match the response to the specific reasons Text 2 gives.
